questions.q: Name three supporting characters in the chapter and state one defining trait for each, based solely on the text.
questions.a: Correct answer: ह्क्स्ज्का (पत्नी) — व्यावहारिक और सुरक्षात्मक; त्एक्ज्क (मित्र) — संवेदनशील और वफादार; उक्द्ज्के — सनकी और अवसरवादी। A wrong answer that lists only names without traits shows the student cannot move beyond recall to character interpretation. A wrong answer that assigns traits not supported by dialogue (e.g., calling ह्क्स्ज्का "क्रूर") reveals the student is projecting stereotypes instead of reading evidence.

questions.q: Explain in your own words why ह्क्स्ज्का urges ल्व्ज्न्कल to accept the bundle of coins from the stranger, and what this reveals about her worldview.
questions.a: Correct answer: ह्क्स्ज्का sees the coins as immediate survival for the family; her worldview prioritizes practical necessity over abstract dignity because she has experienced hunger and instability. A wrong answer that says "she is greedy" or "she doesn't love him" shows the student judges characters morally instead of analyzing their socio-economic constraints. A wrong answer that ignores her fear for the children reveals the student misses the textual evidence of her protective instinct.

questions.q: Using the PEEL structure (Point, Evidence, Explanation, Link), write a short paragraph analyzing how त्एक्ज्क's dialogue in the scene where he confronts ह्क्स्ज्का about the bundle demonstrates his loyalty to ल्व्ज्न्कल.
questions.a: Correct answer: Point — त्एक्ज्क defends ल्व्ज्न्कल's dignity. Evidence — He says, "eqgYysokys rqEgsa HkM+dk,¡xs] ij eSa Hkxoku ls dgrk gw¡". Explanation — He challenges ह्क्स्ज्का's pragmatism by appealing to a higher moral code, showing he values ल्व्ज्न्कल's self-respect over material gain. A wrong answer that claims त्एक्ज्क is "angry at ह्क्स्ज्का" misses the nuance of his motivation.

questions.q: Compare the responses of उक्द्ज्के and ब्कोक्क्ज्न्हु to ल्व्ज्न्कल's refusal to beg. What does the contrast suggest about the community's attitude toward poverty?

questions.q: Evaluate whether फेक्स्म्ह न्स्ज (the landlord) functions more as a plot device or as a fully realized character. Support your judgment with two textual details.

A wrong answer that says "he is just a villain" imposes a moral label the text does not support.

questions.q: Write a 50-word monologue from ल्क्ह्क्क्ष्ह's perspective the night after she visits ल्व्ज्न्कल's hut, revealing her true feelings about his refusal.
questions.a: A strong answer will use first-person voice, reference specific events (the bundle, the children's hunger), and show internal conflict (e.g., "मैंने उसके सिद्धांतों की रक्षा की, पर मेरे बच्चे भूखे सोए"). A weak answer that merely summarizes the plot ("ल्व्ज्न्कल ने पैसे नहीं लिए") shows the student cannot inhabit a character's psychology. A weak answer that makes ल्क्ह्क्क्ष्ह sound like a modern activist ("मैं नारीवादी हूँ") reveals anachronistic projection.
